_comment: MEAL-7 curated canary plans. CURATED DATA, NOT CODE -- these are expected
to need upkeep as stores restock and relist, and that maintenance is the
price of the canary meaning anything.
Each meal is built so ONE run walks every branch the cart engine has. The
items that are supposed to FAIL are the point: a plan where everything
succeeds tests only the happy path, which is the path least likely to
Copy to canary-plans.json and fill in real items per store.

items.why: plain in-stock item: should match and confirm
sold by weight: confirmed by PRESENCE, never by quantity (isWeightPriced)

items.item: <pick something genuinely out of stock here>
items.why: out of stock: proves out_of_stock is not laundered into a match failure
no candidates at all: proves the search reports empty rather than guessing

items.item: <something that returns candidates but none good enough>
items.why: candidates, none matching: proves the scorer REFUSES rather than settles
